scope: Owner-requested mechanical extraction of Day One flow logic from scripts/main.gd into the new RefCounted satellite scripts/day_one_flow.gd (DayOneFlow), the 'safe way': logic only, every Day One field stays on ReefMain and is still saved through DayOneDirector; bodies move verbatim with only an m. receiver prefix (self -> m, ReefMain value constants -> ReefMain.NAME, preloaded script constants re-declared); every moved function reached from outside the satellite keeps a same-signature one-line forwarder on ReefMain, so other scripts, probes, Callable/call_deferred string dispatch and has_method checks are unchanged. Three commits move leaf room-entry/progress recorders first, then castle dressing/art studio/bathroom and pool route helpers, then the story-clip queue and boss/exit chain last. Functions whose source text trusted or voice-contract probes read in main.gd stay on main; no probe, tool or save key is edited. Benefits development: main.gd sheds 310 lines of Day One bodies toward the DL-CODE-01 target without any behavior change for the child.
preserved_contracts: No Day One field moved: DayOneFlow holds only its ReefMain reference; DayOneDirector serialize_state/restore_state and every reef_save.json key are unchanged.
Moved bodies are byte-identical apart from the receiver prefix; call order inside every function is unchanged, including the 2026-09-23 Continue world-before-castle ordering.
Every moved function reached from main, another script, a probe, a tool or a string (m.call, Callable(m, ...), call_deferred) keeps a same-signature forwarder on ReefMain.

Callables created inside moved bodies (the _day_one_trigger_boss entry passed to the Royal Hall seam) are created and consumed through the satellite, which ReefMain owns for its whole lifetime; _show_day_two_transition and its finished handler stay on main together.

Seventeen functions stay on main because probes read their source there: _day_one_ref, day_one_activate_castle_room, day_one_complete_bathroom_scene, day_one_complete_stuffie_rescue, _sync_day_one_bathroom_cleanup, _on_day_one_bathroom_supply_hunt_completed, _on_day_one_bathroom_finale_started, _start_day_one_bathroom_movie_handoff, _day_one_bathroom_entry_movie_blocks_cleanup, _suspend_day_one_bathroom_controls, _sync_day_one_pool_route, _show_day_one_room_handoff, _on_day_one_hook_event, _day_one_play_story_clip, _day_one_play_story_clip_for_room, _show_day_two_transition, _on_day_two_transition_finished.

Eight one-line functions stay on main because a forwarder would be as long as the body: say_day_one_context, reset_day_one_context, day_one_is_active, day_one_jobs_locked, day_one_opera_enabled, _day_one_begin_arrival, _on_day_one_bathroom_cleanup_step, _clear_day_one_pool_route.
No string literal that any probe, tool or test looks for in scripts/main.gd disappears (whole-repository literal sweep).
3D token inventory of scripts/main.gd is identical and the satellite has none, so tools/game_2d_migration_manifest.json is unchanged.
